description: Foundation layer shared by all five pages. Create styles.css (design tokens, base typography, sticky header/nav with mobile hamburger, footer, buttons, skip link, visible focus styles, reveal/animation utility classes, image-zoom, prefers-reduced-motion handling), the self-contained SVG logo files + favicon in assets/, the generic image placeholder + hero in images/, and site.js (mobile menu, Intersection Observer reveals, image onerror fallback). Also document the canonical shared header/footer/logo markup and the inline .js head script that FEAT-002..FEAT-007 must paste byte-identically. No page HTML is edited in this FEAT — pages are rewritten in FEAT-002..FEAT-006. This FEAT leaves the existing site buildable (old pages still render; they simply do not yet use the new shared files).
steps: Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/styles.css. Start with `*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`. Define :root custom properties exactly: --color-ivory #FAF7F0, --color-forest #183D32, --color-saffron #E89B3C, --color-terracotta #B9674D, --color-charcoal #252A27, --color-sage #E5EBDD, --color-white #ffffff, --font-heading ('Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif), --font-body ('Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif), spacing scale --space-1..8 (0.25rem..3rem), --radius-sm 6px/--radius-md 12px/--radius-lg 20px, --transition-fast 150ms ease/--transition-med 250ms ease, --max-width 1200px, --max-width-narrow 760px.

In styles.css add base: html { scroll-behavior:smooth } (disabled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)), body { background:var(--color-ivory); color:var(--color-charcoal); font-family:var(--font-body); line-height:1.6 }, headings h1-h6 { font-family:var(--font-heading); color:var(--color-forest); line-height:1.2 }, img { max-width:100%; height:auto; display:block }, a color var(--color-forest). Add `.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--space-4)}` and `.container--narrow{max-width:var(--max-width-narrow)}`.

In styles.css add the skip link: `.skip-link{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--color-forest);color:#fff;padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);z-index:2000}` and `.skip-link:focus{left:var(--space-2);top:var(--space-2)}`. Add visible focus styles for all interactive elements: `:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-saffron);outline-offset:2px}` (never outline:none without this replacement).

In styles.css add the sticky header: `.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:var(--color-forest);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15)}`, `.site-header__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--space-3);min-height:64px}`, `.site-logo img{height:44px;width:auto}`, `.primary-nav__list{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:var(--space-5);margin:0}`, `.primary-nav__list a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;padding:var(--space-2) 0;position:relative}`, `.primary-nav__list a:hover{color:var(--color-saffron)}`, `.primary-nav__list a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--color-saffron)}` and an underline indicator for hover/active.

In styles.css add the mobile hamburger + collapse behaviour with progressive enhancement: `.nav-toggle{display:none}` by default; under `@media (max-width:768px)` show the button (`display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:0;padding:.5rem`), style the three bars, and `.js .primary-nav{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:var(--color-forest);flex-direction:column;gap:0;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height var(--transition-med)}` with `.js .primary-nav.is-open{max-height:80vh;overflow:auto}`. WITHOUT `.js` (no JS) the `.primary-nav__list` stays `display:flex` (visible and usable) — do not hide it without the `.js` class. `aria-expanded` is toggled in JS; also reflect open state visually via `.is-open`.

In styles.css add the footer: `.site-footer{background:var(--color-forest);color:#e8e4dc}`, `.site-footer__inner{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-6);padding-block:var(--space-7)`, two columns (brand + links), `.site-footer__brand img{height:44px;margin-bottom:var(--space-3)}`, `.site-footer__heading{font-family:var(--font-heading);color:var(--color-saffron)}`, footer links list style none, link color #e8e4dc hover saffron, `.site-footer__bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);text-align:center;padding-block:var(--space-4);font-size:.85rem}`. No phone number anywhere.

In styles.css add buttons: `.btn{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;border-radius:999px;padding:.8rem 1.6rem;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform var(--transition-fast),background var(--transition-fast),color var(--transition-fast)}`, `.btn--primary{background:var(--color-saffron);color:var(--color-forest)}`, `.btn--primary:hover{background:#d98a2c;transform:translateY(-2px)}`, `.btn--secondary{background:transparent;border-color:#fff;color:#fff}`, `.btn--secondary:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--color-forest)}`. Ensure focus styles inherit from :focus-visible above.

In styles.css add reveal/animation utility classes with progressive enhancement: default (no .js) `.reveal{opacity:1}` (visible). Under `.js .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}` and `.js .reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none}`. Stagger: `.js .reveal[data-delay]{transition-delay:var(--reveal-delay,0ms)}` (JS sets `--reveal-delay`). Image-zoom: `.zoom-img{overflow:hidden}` and `.zoom-img img{transition:transform var(--transition-med)}` `.zoom-img:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}`. Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .js .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none} .zoom-img:hover img{transform:none} *{scroll-behavior:auto} }`.

Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/assets/logo.svg (light-background, dark text/mark). Use an SVG with: a minimal India silhouette path (forest green), a small saffron sun circle, and a heritage arch/torana motif; to the right a wordmark <text> 'INCREDIBLE INDIA' (font-family="'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif", fill var forest/charcoal) and a tagline <text> 'Discover the Extraordinary' (font-family="'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif", smaller, terracotta/charcoal). Set an explicit viewBox and width/height. NO external requests inside the SVG.

Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/assets/logo-dark.svg identical geometry to logo.svg but with LIGHT fills (white/saffron) for use on the forest header/footer background. Create assets/logo-mark.svg (mark only, no text) and assets/favicon.svg (small square mark only, e.g. 64x64, self-contained). All four are self-contained (no <image href> to external URLs, no external font @font-face).

Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/images/placeholder.svg: on-brand gradient (forest→saffron diagonal) + a subtle dot/line pattern + the <text> 'Incredible India' (ivory). This is the onerror fallback. Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/images/hero.svg: a richer gradient composition (forest + saffron + sage) with subtle arch/mountain motifs + a faint 'Incredible India' watermark, sized wide (e.g. viewBox 1600x900) for the home hero overlay.

Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/site.js (vanilla, defer-safe, no modules). (a) Mobile menu: query `.nav-toggle` and `#primary-nav`; toggle `.is-open` and set `navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen)` and the label to 'Close menu'/'Open menu'; close on document keydown Escape, on document click outside the header, and on click of any `.primary-nav__list a`. (b) Reveals: if not prefers-reduced-motion, use IntersectionObserver to add `.is-visible` to `.reveal`; stagger siblings by setting `style.setProperty('--reveal-delay', i*80+'ms')`; if prefers-reduced-motion, add `.is-visible` to all `.reveal` immediately. (c) Image onerror: `window.addEventListener('error', e => { const img=e.target; if(img&&img.tagName==='IMG'&&img.dataset.fallback!=='1'){img.dataset.fallback='1';img.src='images/placeholder.svg';} }, true)` (capture phase, loop-guarded).

Record in this FEAT's `findings` field the FULL canonical `<head>` block, skip link, header markup, footer markup, and the `<script src="site.js" defer></script>` line (see plan.md 'Shared markup'), so FEAT-002..006 paste them byte-identically. Note the logo-text tradeoff (SVG <text> with local font-family stack; no external requests; falls back gracefully). Note favicon.png was not generated (no rasterizer).

=== scripts before (all pages get site.js; gallery adds gallery.js; contact adds contact.js) === === Tradeoffs to record in README === (1) Logo wordmark/tagline use SVG with a local font-family stack (Playfair Display/Inter with serif/sans fallbacks); the SVG makes NO external requests, and falls back gracefully if web fonts are unavailable. (2) favicon.png was NOT generated because no SVG rasterizer (magick/rsvg-convert/inkscape/sharp) is installed; favicon.svg is used instead. Do not block on PNG. === FEAT-001 IMPLEMENTATION NOTES (for FEAT-002..007) === - Shared head/skip-link/header/footer/script markup above is the single source of truth; paste it byte-identically (only title/meta-description/per-page-css filename and the aria-current link differ). - LOGO TRADEOFF: the wordmark and tagline are SVG using a local font-family stack ('Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif and 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif). The SVGs make NO external requests and fall back gracefully if web fonts are unavailable. Hand-converting the wordmark to vector outlines was deemed impractical to author reliably; this tradeoff is approved by the brief. - FAVICON: favicon.png was NOT generated (no rasterizer installed: magick/rsvg-convert/inkscape/sharp). favicon.svg is used instead. Note this in README. - styles.css provides: :root tokens; .container / .container--narrow; .site-header / .site-header__inner; .site-logo; .nav-toggle (3x .nav-toggle__bar) + #primary-nav + .primary-nav__list; .site-footer / .site-footer__inner / .site-footer__brand / .site-footer__links / .site-footer__heading / .site-footer__bottom; .btn / .btn--primary / .btn--secondary; .reveal (with optional data-delay + --reveal-delay set by site.js); .zoom-img; .skip-link; a global :focus-visible saffron outline. Use these classes verbatim. - MOBILE NAV: the hamburger button is shown ONLY under .js (so without JS there is NO inert button; the nav list wraps and stays visible and usable). Collapse breakpoint is max-width: 768px. The inline head script that adds .js is REQUIRED before paint to hide reveals and collapse the menu without FOUC. - site.js behaviour: toggles .is-open + aria-expanded on .nav-toggle; closes on Escape (returns focus to the toggle), outside-click (outside .site-header), nav-link click, and resize to desktop (>768px). Reveals: IntersectionObserver adds .is-visible (one-shot); staggered siblings get data-delay + --reveal-delay at 80ms steps; prefers-reduced-motion or no observer -> all .is-visible immediately. Image onerror (capture phase) swaps a broken to images/placeholder.svg, loop-guarded via data-fallback. - LINK ORDER: link styles.css BEFORE the page's own CSS. Every needs width + height + loading='lazy' (hero is eager) + meaningful alt (decorative -> alt=''). The onerror fallback path is relative images/placeholder.svg (pages live at the repo root). - Destination ids (unchanged): rajasthan, kerala, himachal-pradesh, uttarakhand, goa, varanasi. More-to-explore row: Leh-Ladakh, Andaman & Nicobar, Mysore. - python http.server note: the `python` alias on this machine is the Microsoft Store stub; use `py -m http.server 8000` (py launcher, Python 3.14) to serve.
